intro.en: A reading about solar, mechanical, electrical and heat energy. Read slowly and notice how each type is explained with a use.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum taqat (energy) ki qismon ke baare mein parhenge: shamsi, mekaniki, bijli aur hararat wali taqat. Har qism ke saath uska istemal bhi bataya gaya hai.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ عَنِ الطّاقَةِ الشَّمْسِيَّةِ وَالمِيكانيكِيَّةِ وَالكَهْرَبائِيَّةِ وَالحَرارِيَّةِ. اقْرَأْ بِبُطْءٍ وَانْتَبِهْ إِلى شَرْحِ كُلِّ نَوْعٍ مَعَ اسْتِعْمالِهِ.

dialogue.ar: لا تَقومُ حَياتُنا اليَوْمَ بِغَيْرِ الطّاقَةِ، فَهِيَ تُضيءُ بُيوتَنا وَتُحَرِّكُ مَرْكَباتِنا.
dialogue.tr: lā taqūmu ḥaiyātunā l-yawma bighayri ṭ-ṭāqati, fahiya tuḍīʾu bīūtanā watuḥarriku markabātinā.
dialogue.en: Our life today does not stand without energy: it lights our homes and moves our vehicles.
dialogue.ur: Aaj hamari zindagi tawanai ke baghair qaim nahin reh sakti: yeh hamare ghar roshan karti aur hamari sawariyan chalati hai.

dialogue.ar: وَلِلطّاقَةِ أَنْواعٌ كَثيرَةٌ، سَنَتَعَرَّفُ هُنا إِلى أَرْبَعَةٍ مِنْها.
dialogue.tr: walilṭṭāqati anwāʿun kathīratun, sanataʿarrafu hunā ilā arbaʿatin minhā.
dialogue.en: Energy has many types; here we will get to know four of them.
dialogue.ur: Tawanai ki bohat si qismein hain, yahan hum un mein se chaar se waqif honge.

dialogue.ar: أَوَّلاً، الطّاقَةُ الشَّمْسِيَّةُ: فَالشَّمْسُ هِيَ المَصْدَرُ الأَكْبَرُ لِلضَّوْءِ وَالحَرارَةِ عَلى الأَرْضِ.
dialogue.tr: awwalan, aṭ-ṭāqatu sh-shamsiyyatu: fa-sh-shamsu hiya l-maṣdaru l-ʾakbaru lilḍḍawʾi wa-l-ḥarārati ʿalā l-ʾarḍ.
dialogue.en: First, solar energy: the sun is the greatest source of light and heat on earth.
dialogue.ur: Pehli, shamsi tawanai: sooraj zameen par roshni aur garmi ka sab se bara sarchashma hai.

dialogue.ar: وَتَحْتاجُ الأَشْجارُ وَالنَّباتاتُ إِلى أَشِعَّتِها لِتَنْمُوَ وَتُنْتِجَ الثِّمارَ.
dialogue.tr: wataḥtāju l-ʾashjāru wa-n-nabātātu ilā ashiʿʿatihā litanmuwa watuntija th-thimār.
dialogue.en: Trees and plants need its rays in order to grow and produce fruit.
dialogue.ur: Darakhton aur paudhon ko us ki shuaon ki zaroorat hoti hai taake woh barhen aur phal den.

dialogue.ar: وَيَضَعُ بَعْضُ النّاسِ عَلى سُطوحِ مَنازِلِهِمْ أَلْواحاً تَجْمَعُ هَذِهِ الأَشِعَّةَ لِتُسَخِّنَ الماءَ.
dialogue.tr: wayaḍaʿu baʿḍu n-nāsi ʿalā suṭūḥi manāzilihim alwāḥan tajmaʿu hādhihi l-ʾashiʿʿata litusakhkhina l-māʾ.
dialogue.en: Some people place panels on the roofs of their houses that gather these rays to heat water.
dialogue.ur: Kuch log apne gharon ki chhaton par aise takhte lagate hain jo in shuaon ko jama kar ke pani garam karte hain.

dialogue.ar: ثانِياً، الطّاقَةُ المِيكانيكِيَّةُ: هِيَ طاقَةُ الأَجْسامِ المُتَحَرِّكَةِ، مِثْلَ الرِّياحِ القَوِيَّةِ وَالمِياهِ المُنْدَفِعَةِ.
dialogue.tr: thānīan, aṭ-ṭāqatu l-mīkānīkiyyatu: hiya ṭāqatu l-ʾajsāmi l-mutaḥarrikati, mithla r-riyāḥi l-qawiyyati wa-l-miyāhi l-mundafiʿati.
dialogue.en: Second, mechanical energy: it is the energy of moving bodies, like strong winds and rushing water.
dialogue.ur: Doosri, mikaniki tawanai: yeh harkat karne wali cheezon ki tawanai hai, jaise tez hawayen aur tezi se behta pani.

dialogue.ar: وَقَدْ دارَتْ طَواحينُ الهَواءِ قَديماً بِالرِّياحِ لِطَحْنِ القَمْحِ وَرَفْعِ الماءِ.
dialogue.tr: waqad dārat ṭawāḥīnu l-hawāʾi qadīman bi-r-riyāḥi liṭaḥni l-qamḥi warafʿi l-māʾ.
dialogue.en: Windmills long ago turned with the winds to grind wheat and lift water.
dialogue.ur: Purane zamane mein hawa ki chakkiyan hawaon se ghoomti theen taake gandum pisen aur pani kheenchen.

dialogue.ar: وَتُعَدُّ الرِّياحُ مَصْدَراً نَظيفاً، فَلا دُخانَ فيها وَلا أَذى لِلْبيئَةِ.
dialogue.tr: watuʿaddu r-riyāḥu maṣdaran naẓīfan, falā dukhāna fīhā walā adhā lilbīʾati.
dialogue.en: Wind is counted as a clean source: it has no smoke and no harm to the environment.
dialogue.ur: Hawaon ko saaf sarchashma mana jata hai: un mein na dhuan hai na mahaul ko nuqsan.

dialogue.ar: ثالِثاً، الطّاقَةُ الكَهْرَبائِيَّةُ: نَسْتَعْمِلُها في الإِنارَةِ وَتَشْغيلِ الأَجْهِزَةِ في المَنازِلِ وَالمَصانِعِ.
dialogue.tr: thālithan, aṭ-ṭāqatu l-kahrabāʾiyyatu: nastaʿmiluhā fī l-ʾinārati watashghīli l-ʾajhizati fī l-manāzili wa-l-maṣāniʿ.
dialogue.en: Third, electrical energy: we use it for lighting and running devices in homes and factories.
dialogue.ur: Teesri, bijli ki tawanai: hum use roshni aur gharon aur karkhanon mein aaliyat chalane ke liye istemal karte hain.

dialogue.ar: وَتُولَّدُ في مَحَطّاتٍ عِنْدَ السُّدودِ، حينَ تَنْدَفِعُ المِياهُ مِنْ مَكانٍ عالٍ فَتُديرُ الآلاتِ.
dialogue.tr: watūlladu fī maḥaṭṭātin ʿinda s-sudūd, ḥīna tandafiʿu l-miyāhu min makānin ʿālin fatudīru l-ʾālāt.
dialogue.en: It is generated in stations at dams, when water rushes from a high place and turns the machines.
dialogue.ur: Yeh bandon par bane markazon mein paida hoti hai, jab pani buland jagah se tezi se gir kar mashinon ko ghumata hai.

dialogue.ar: وَمِنْ فَوائِدِها أَنَّها تَنْتَقِلُ عَبْرَ الأَسْلاكِ إِلى مُدُنٍ بَعيدَةٍ بِسُهولَةٍ.
dialogue.tr: wamin fawāʾidihā annahā tantaqilu ʿabra l-ʾaslāki ilā mudunin baʿīdatin bisuhūlatin.
dialogue.en: One of its benefits is that it travels through wires to distant cities easily.
dialogue.ur: Us ke faidon mein se yeh hai ke woh taron ke zariye door ke shehron tak aasani se pohanch jati hai.

dialogue.ar: رابِعاً، الطّاقَةُ الحَرارِيَّةُ: نَحْصُلُ عَلَيْها حينَ نُحْرِقُ الوَقودَ، وَحينَ تَحْتَكُّ الأَجْسامُ فَتَسْخُنُ.
dialogue.tr: rābiʿan, aṭ-ṭāqatu l-ḥarāriyyatu: naḥṣulu ʿalayhā ḥīna nuḥriqu l-waqūd, waḥīna taḥtakku l-ʾajsāmu fataskhun.
dialogue.en: Fourth, heat energy: we get it when we burn fuel, and when objects rub together and get hot.
dialogue.ur: Chauthi, hararati tawanai: yeh hamein eendhan jalane se milti hai aur jab cheezein ek doosre se ragad kar garam hoti hain.

dialogue.ar: وَنَحْتاجُها لِلطَّهْيِ وَالتَّسْخينِ وَتَدْفِئَةِ البُيوتِ في الشِّتاءِ.
dialogue.tr: wanaḥtājuhā lilṭṭahyi wa-t-taskhīni watadfiʾati l-bīūti fī sh-shitāʾ.
dialogue.en: We need it for cooking, heating and warming homes in winter.
dialogue.ur: Hamein us ki zaroorat khana pakane, garam karne aur sardiyon mein gharon ko garam rakhne ke liye hoti hai.

dialogue.ar: وَيَنْبَغي أَنْ نُحْسِنَ اسْتِعْمالَ كُلِّ هَذِهِ الأَنْواعِ، وَنُحافِظَ عَلى البيئَةِ.
dialogue.tr: wayanbaghī an nuḥsina stiʿmāla kulli hādhihi l-ʾanwāʿ, wanuḥāfiẓa ʿalā l-bīʾati.
dialogue.en: We should use all these types well and take care of the environment.
dialogue.ur: Hamein in tamam qismon ko achhe tareeqe se istemal karna chahiye aur mahaul ki hifazat karni chahiye.

q.en: Which source gives the earth light and heat?
q.ur: Zameen ko roshni aur hararat kaun deta hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ مَصْدَرٍ يُعْطي الأَرْضَ الضَّوْءَ وَالحَرارَةَ؟

q.en: What does «مَصْدَرٌ نَظيفٌ» mean about wind energy?
q.ur: «مَصْدَرٌ نَظيفٌ» ka matlab hawa ki taqat ke liye?
q.ar: ماذا تَعْني عِبارَةُ «مَصْدَرٌ نَظيفٌ» عَنْ طاقَةِ الرِّياحِ؟

q.en: Which energy is easy to carry by wires?
q.ur: Taaron se aasani se kaun si taqat pahunchti hai?
Hararati taqat kis ke liye zaroori hai?

title.en: Grammar A: Nouns in the genitive (majrūr)

intro.en: A noun is majrūr (ends with kasra) when it comes after a preposition, when it is the second part of an idāfa, or when it follows a majrūr noun as a describing or replacing word. Example: فِي تَقَدُّمٍ - in progress (تَقَدُّمٍ comes after فِي).
intro.ur: Ism majroor (kasra par khatam) tab hota hai jab woh harf-e-jar ke baad aaye, mudaf ilayh ho, ya kisi majroor ism ka tabi ho (sifat, badal wagaira). Misal: فِي تَقَدُّمٍ - taraqqi mein (تَقَدُّمٍ, فِي ke baad).
intro.ar: يَكونُ الِاسْمُ مَجْروراً (آخِرُهُ كَسْرَةٌ) إِذا جاءَ بَعْدَ حَرْفِ جَرٍّ، أَوْ كانَ المُضافَ إِلَيْهِ، أَوْ كانَ تابِعاً لِاسْمٍ مَجْرورٍ كَالصِّفَةِ أَوِ البَدَلِ. مِثالٌ: «في تَقَدُّمٍ»؛ فَكَلِمَةُ «تَقَدُّمٍ» جاءَتْ بَعْدَ «في».

q.en: A noun after a preposition is:
q.ur: Harf-e-jar ke baad ism hota hai:

q.en: What sign does a majrūr noun usually carry?
q.ur: Majroor ism par aam taur par kaun si alamat hoti hai?

intro.en: Listen to a text about water, then mark each statement true or false. Here are the statements as written, to read and think about.
intro.ur: Pani ke baare mein ek matan suniye, phir har jumle ko sahi ya ghalat nishan lagaiye. Neeche jumle likhe hain, parh kar soochiye.
intro.ar: اسْتَمِعْ إِلى نَصٍّ عَنِ الماءِ، ثُمَّ احْكُمْ عَلى كُلِّ جُمْلَةٍ بِصَحيحٍ أَوْ خَطَأٍ. هذِهِ الجُمَلُ مَكْتوبَةٌ لِتَقْرَأَها وَتُفَكِّرَ فيها.

dialogue.ar: الماءُ يُغَطّي مِساحَةً كَبيرَةً مِنْ سَطْحِ الأَرْضِ.
dialogue.tr: al-māʾu yughaṭṭī misāḥatan kabīratan min saṭḥi l-ʾarḍ.
dialogue.en: Water covers a large area of the earth's surface.
dialogue.ur: Pani zameen ki sath ke bare hisse ko dhanke hue hai.

dialogue.ar: يوجَدُ بُخارُ الماءِ في الهَواءِ الَّذي نَتَنَفَّسُهُ.
dialogue.tr: yūjadu bukhāru l-māʾi fī l-hawāʾi alladhī natanaffasuh.
dialogue.en: There is water vapour in the air we breathe.
dialogue.ur: Jis hawa mein hum saans lete hain us mein pani ki bhaap maujood hai.

dialogue.ar: لا تَسْتَغْني الحَضاراتُ عَنِ الماءِ في الماضِي وَالحاضِرِ.
dialogue.tr: lā tastaghnī l-ḥaḍārātu ʿani l-māʾi fī l-māḍī wa-l-ḥāḍir.
dialogue.en: Civilisations do not do without water, in the past and the present.
dialogue.ur: Tehzeebein maazi aur haal mein pani se be-niyaz nahin ho sakti.

dialogue.ar: الماءُ نِعْمَةٌ إِذا أَحْسَنّا اسْتِعْمالَهُ، وَقَدْ يَصيرُ نِقْمَةً في الفَيَضاناتِ.
dialogue.tr: al-māʾu niʿmatun idhā aḥsannā stiʿmālah, waqad yaṣīru niqmatan fī l-fayaḍānāt.
dialogue.en: Water is a blessing if we use it well, and it may become a punishment in floods.
dialogue.ur: Agar hum achhe tareeqe se istemal karen to pani nemat hai, aur seelab mein azaab ban sakta hai.

dialogue.ar: اخْتارَ النّاسُ قَديماً أَنْ يَسْكُنوا قَريباً مِنْ مَصادِرِ المِياهِ.
dialogue.tr: khtāra n-nāsu qadīman an yaskunū qarīban min maṣādiri l-miyāh.
dialogue.en: In ancient times people chose to live near sources of water.
dialogue.ur: Qadeem zamane mein log pani ke sarchashmon ke qareeb rehna pasand karte the.

dialogue.ar: الماءُ الصّالِحُ لِلشُّرْبِ جُزْءٌ صَغيرٌ مِنْ مِياهِ الأَرْضِ.
dialogue.tr: al-māʾu ṣ-ṣāliḥu lilshshurbi juzʾun ṣaghīrun min miyāhi l-ʾarḍ.
dialogue.en: Water fit for drinking is a small part of the water of the earth.
dialogue.ur: Peene ke laiq pani zameen ke pani ka ek chhota hissa hai.

dialogue.ar: يَزْدادُ سُكّانُ العالَمِ كُلَّ سَنَةٍ، فَيَزْدادُ الطَّلَبُ عَلى الماءِ.
dialogue.tr: yazdādu sukkānu l-ʿālami kulla sanatin, fayazdādu ṭ-ṭalabu ʿalā l-māʾ.
dialogue.en: The world's inhabitants increase every year, so the demand for water increases.
dialogue.ur: Duniya ki aabadi har saal barhti hai, is liye pani ki talab barhti hai.

dialogue.ar: تُعاني بَعْضُ البِلادِ الفَقيرَةِ مِنْ قِلَّةِ المِياهِ النَّظيفَةِ.
dialogue.tr: tuʿānī baʿḍu l-bilādi l-faqīrati min qillati l-miyāhi n-naẓīfati.
dialogue.en: Some poor countries suffer from a lack of clean water.
dialogue.ur: Kuch gareeb mulk saaf pani ki kami se dochar hain.

options_ar: ما يُنْعِمُ اللهُ بِهِ عَلى عِبادِهِ

title.ur: Sunna aur samajhna (2): Pani ke istemal

intro.en: A second listening text about how water is used: in farming, sports, industry and homes. Read the statements and think whether each is true.
intro.ur: Doosra matan: pani kin kaamon mein istemal hota hai (kheti, khel, sanat, ghar). Jumle parhiye aur soochiye kaun sa sahi hai.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ ثانٍ لِلِاسْتِماعِ عَنِ اسْتِعْمالاتِ الماءِ في الزِّراعَةِ وَالرِّياضَةِ وَالصِّناعَةِ وَالبُيوتِ. اقْرَأِ الجُمَلَ وَفَكِّرْ: هَلْ هِيَ صَحيحَةٌ؟

dialogue.ar: تُسْتَعْمَلُ مِياهُ الأَمْطارِ وَالأَنْهارِ في سَقْيِ المَزارِعِ.
dialogue.tr: tustaʿmalu miyāhu l-ʾamṭāri wa-l-ʾanhāri fī saqyi l-mazāriʿ.
dialogue.en: The water of rains and rivers is used to irrigate farms.
dialogue.ur: Barish aur nadiyon ka pani kheton ki sinchai mein istemal hota hai.

dialogue.ar: تَحْتاجُ المَصانِعُ إِلى كَمِّيّاتٍ كَبيرَةٍ مِنَ الماءِ في الصِّناعَةِ.
dialogue.tr: taḥtāju l-maṣāniʿu ilā kammiyyātin kabīratin mina l-māʾi fī ṣ-ṣināʿati.
dialogue.en: Factories need large amounts of water in industry.
dialogue.ur: Karkhanon ko sanat mein pani ki bari miqdar ki zaroorat hoti hai.

dialogue.ar: يُسْرِفُ بَعْضُ النّاسِ في الماءِ لِمُجَرَّدِ الرَّفاهِيَةِ.
dialogue.tr: yusrifu baʿḍu n-nāsi fī l-māʾi limujarradi r-rafāhiyati.
dialogue.en: Some people waste water merely for luxury.
dialogue.ur: Kuch log sirf aish o aaram ke liye pani zaya karte hain.

dialogue.ar: السِّباحَةُ رِياضَةٌ مُرْتَبِطَةٌ بِالماءِ.
dialogue.tr: as-sibāḥatu riyāḍatun murtabiṭatun bi-l-māʾ.
dialogue.en: Swimming is a sport linked to water.
dialogue.ur: Tairaki aisi khel hai jo pani se juda hai.

dialogue.ar: تُلْقي بَعْضُ المَصانِعِ فَضَلاتِها في الأَنْهارِ وَالبُحَيْراتِ وَالبِحارِ فَتُلَوِّثُها.
dialogue.tr: tulqī baʿḍu l-maṣāniʿi faḍalātihā fī l-ʾanhāri wa-l-buḥayrāti wa-l-biḥāri fatulawwithuhā.
dialogue.en: Some factories throw their waste into rivers, lakes and seas and pollute them.
dialogue.ur: Kuch karkhane apna fuzla nadiyon, jheelon aur samundaron mein daalte hain aur unhein aaloodah kar dete hain.

dialogue.ar: ماءٌ جارٍ في المَنازِلِ نِعْمَةٌ لا تَصِلُ إِلى كُلِّ البُيوتِ.
dialogue.tr: māʾun jārin fī l-manāzili niʿmatun lā taṣilu ilā kulli l-bīūt.
dialogue.en: Running water in homes is a blessing that does not reach every house.
dialogue.ur: Gharon mein behta hua pani aisi nemat hai jo har ghar tak nahin pohanchti.

dialogue.ar: لِلْماءِ اسْتِعْمالاتٌ كَثيرَةٌ، وَلِكُلِّ اسْتِعْمالٍ غَرَضٌ مُخْتَلِفٌ.
dialogue.tr: lilmāʾi stiʿmālātun kathīratun, walikulli stiʿmālin gharaḍun mukhtalifun.
dialogue.en: Water has many uses, and each use has a different purpose.
dialogue.ur: Pani ke bohat se istemal hain aur har istemal ka maqsad alag hai.

options_ar: غَرْسُ النَّباتاتِ وَرِعايَتُها لِلْحُصولِ عَلى الطَّعامِ
تَحْويلُ المَوادِّ إِلى سِلَعٍ في المَصانِعِ
مَجارٍ كَبيرَةٌ يَجْري فيها الماءُ العَذْبُ
ماءٌ لا يَأْتي إِلّا مِنَ المَطَرِ

intro.en: Practise reciting the poem of Mālik ibn ar-Rayb at-Tamīmī, in which he mourns himself. Then choose a poem you like, memorize part of it and recite it before classmates.
intro.ur: Malik bin ar-Raib at-Tamimi ka qaseeda (jis mein woh apna marsiya kehte hain) parhne ki mashq. Phir apni pasand ka ek qaseeda chun kar uska hissa yaad kijiye aur sathiyon ke saamne sunaiye.
intro.ar: نَتَدَرَّبُ هُنا عَلى قَصيدَةِ مالِكِ بْنِ الرَّيْبِ التَّميميِّ الَّتي يَرْثي فيها نَفْسَهُ. ثُمَّ اخْتَرْ قَصيدَةً تُحِبُّها وَاحْفَظْ جُزْءاً مِنْها وَأَنْشِدْهُ أَمامَ زُمَلائِكَ.

dialogue.ar: أَلا لَيْتَ شِعْري هَلْ أَبيتَنَّ لَيْلَةً
dialogue.tr: alā layta shiʿrī hal abītanna layla
dialogue.en: If only I knew whether I will spend a night...
dialogue.ur: Kaash mujhe maloom hota ke kya main ek raat guzaroon...

dialogue.ar: فَقَدْ كُنْتُ عَطّافاً إِذا الخَيْلُ أَحْجَمَتْ
dialogue.tr: fa-qad kuntu ʿaṭṭāfan idhā l-khaylu aḥjamat
dialogue.en: For I was one who charged when the horses held back.
dialogue.ur: Main woh tha jo ghodon ke peechay hatne par bhi hamla karta tha.

dialogue.ar: وَلا تَحْسُداني، بارَكَ اللهُ فيكُما
dialogue.tr: wa lā taḥsudānī, bāraka llāhu fīkumā
dialogue.en: Do not envy me, may Allah bless you both.
dialogue.ur: Mujh par hasad na karna, Allah tum dono mein barkat de.

dialogue.ar: فَلا تَنْسِيا عَهْدي خَليلَيَّ إِنَّني
dialogue.tr: fa-lā tansiyā ʿahdī khalīlayya innanī
dialogue.en: Do not forget my pledge, my two friends.
dialogue.ur: Aye mere do dosto, mera ahd na bhoolna.

شِعْرٌ يُقالُ في بُكاءِ الميِّتِ وَذِكْرِ مَحاسِنِهِ

q.ur: Is mashq mein kya karna hai?
q.ar: ماذا يُطْلَبُ مِنْكَ في هذا التَّمْرينِ؟

title.en: Grammar B: Parsing the present verb

intro.en: The present verb is marfūʿ (damma) if nothing comes before it. It is manṣūb after أَنْ، لَنْ، كَيْ and similar particles, and majzūm after لَمْ، لا النّاهِيَة، لامُ الأَمْر and conditional words. Example: لَمْ يَغِبِ الحارِسُ - the guard was not absent.
intro.ur: Fel-e-mudari marfu (pesh) hota hai agar us se pehle kuch na ho. Woh أَنْ، لَنْ، كَيْ aur in jaise harf ke baad mansub, aur لَمْ، لا-e-nahiya، lam-e-amr aur sharti alfaaz ke baad majzum hota hai. Misal: لَمْ يَغِبِ الحارِسُ - chowkidar ghair-hazir nahin hua.
intro.ar: الفِعْلُ المُضارِعُ مَرْفوعٌ بِالضَّمَّةِ إِذا لَمْ يَسْبِقْهُ شَيْءٌ، وَمَنْصوبٌ بَعْدَ أَنْ وَلَنْ وَكَيْ وَنَحْوِها، وَمَجْزومٌ بَعْدَ لَمْ وَلا النّاهِيَةِ وَلامِ الأَمْرِ وَأَدَواتِ الشَّرْطِ. مِثالٌ: «لَمْ يَغِبِ الحارِسُ».

dialogue.ar: يَسْعَدُ الطّالِبُ المُجْتَهِدُ بِنَجاحِهِ.
dialogue.tr: yasʿadu ṭ-ṭālibu l-mujtahidu binajāḥih.
dialogue.en: The hard-working student is happy with his success. (marfūʿ: nothing before it)
dialogue.ur: Mehnati talib-e-ilm apni kamyabi par khush hota hai. (marfu: us se pehle kuch nahin)

dialogue.ar: أُريدُ أَنْ أَزورَ جَدّي في العُطْلَةِ.
dialogue.tr: urīdu an azūra jaddī fī l-ʿuṭlati.
dialogue.en: I want to visit my grandfather during the holiday. (manṣūb after «أَنْ»)
dialogue.ur: Main chhuttiyon mein apne dada se milna chahta hoon. («أَنْ» ke baad mansub)

dialogue.ar: لَنْ يَتَأَخَّرَ المُسافِرُ عَنِ المَوْعِدِ.
dialogue.tr: lan yataʾakhkhara l-musāfiru ʿani l-mawʿid.
dialogue.en: The traveller will not be late for the appointment. (manṣūb after «لَنْ»)
dialogue.ur: Musafir waqt se der nahin karega. («لَنْ» ke baad mansub)

dialogue.ar: لَمْ يَغِبِ الحارِسُ عَنْ مَكانِهِ.
dialogue.tr: lam yaghibi l-ḥārisu ʿan makānih.
dialogue.en: The guard was not absent from his place. (majzūm after «لَمْ»)
dialogue.ur: Chowkidar apni jagah se ghair-hazir nahin hua. («لَمْ» ke baad majzum)

dialogue.ar: لِيَجْتَهِدْ كُلُّ طالِبٍ في دُروسِهِ.
dialogue.tr: liyajtahid kullu ṭālibin fī durūsih.
dialogue.en: Let every student work hard in his lessons. (majzūm after the command «لِ»)
dialogue.ur: Har talib-e-ilm apne sabaq mein mehnat kare. (lam-e-amr ke baad majzum)

dialogue.ar: سافَرْتُ كَيْ أَطْلُبَ العِلْمَ.
dialogue.tr: sāfartu kay aṭluba l-ʿilm.
dialogue.en: I travelled so that I may seek knowledge. (manṣūb after «كَيْ»)
dialogue.ur: Main is liye safar par gaya ke ilm hasil karoon. («كَيْ» ke baad mansub)

dialogue.ar: إِنْ تَصْبِرْ تَنَلْ ما تُريدُ.
dialogue.tr: in taṣbir tanal mā turīd.
dialogue.en: If you are patient, you will get what you want. (both verbs majzūm after «إِنْ»)
dialogue.ur: Agar tum sabr karo to jo chahte ho paa loge. («إِنْ» ke baad dono fel majzum)

dialogue.ar: مَتى تُنْفِقْ في الخَيْرِ يُبارِكِ اللهُ في مالِكَ.
dialogue.tr: matā tunfiq fī l-khayri yubāriki Allāh fī mālik.
dialogue.en: Whenever you spend on good, Allah blesses your wealth. (majzūm after «مَتى»)
dialogue.ur: Jab bhi tum bhalai mein kharch karoge Allah tumhare maal mein barkat dega. («مَتى» ke baad majzum)

q.ur: «لَنْ» ke baad fel mudari hota hai:
«لَمْ» ke baad fel mudari hota hai:
«لَنْ يَتَأَخَّرَ المُسافِرُ» ka kya matlab hai?

options: The traveller will not be late

title.en: Extended reading: The mender of the noble's slips
title.ur: Wasee muta'ala: Kareemon ki laghzishon ko sanwarne wala

intro.en: A story of generosity and gratitude: Nabil, a generous merchant, loses his wealth and hides from his creditors out of shyness. A masked visitor who calls himself «جابِرُ عَثَراتِ الكِرامِ» comes by night to rescue him. Read the dialogue in order.
intro.ur: Sakhawat aur wafadari ki kahani: ek sakhi tajir Nabeel apna maal kho deta hai aur sharm ke maare qarz khwahon se chhup jata hai. Ek naqabposh mulaqati jo apne aap ko «جابِرُ عَثَراتِ الكِرامِ» kehta hai raat ko us ki madad ko aata hai. Guftagu tarteeb se parhein.
intro.ar: قِصَّةٌ في الكَرَمِ وَالوَفاءِ: يَفْقِدُ نَبيلٌ، وَهُوَ تاجِرٌ كَريمٌ، مالَهُ وَيَخْتَبِئُ مِنَ الغُرَماءِ حَياءً. فَيَأْتيهِ في اللَّيْلِ زائِرٌ مُلَثَّمٌ يُسَمّي نَفْسَهُ «جابِرَ عَثَراتِ الكِرامِ» لِيُنْقِذَهُ. اقْرَأِ الحِوارَ بِالتَّرْتيبِ.

dialogue.ar: كانَ نَبيلٌ تاجِراً كَريماً لا يَرُدُّ سائِلاً، حَتّى غَرِقَتْ سَفينَتُهُ وَضاعَ مالُهُ، فَصارَ الغُرَماءُ يَقِفونَ عَلى بابِهِ.
dialogue.tr: kāna nabīlun tājiran karīman lā yaruddu sāʾilan, ḥattā ghariqat safīnatuhu waḍāʿa māluh, faṣāra l-ghuramāʾu yaqifūna ʿalā bābih.
dialogue.en: Nabil was a generous merchant who never turned away a beggar, until his ship sank and his money was lost, and the creditors began to stand at his door.
dialogue.ur: Nabeel ek sakhi tajir tha jo kisi sawali ko wapas nahin karta tha, yahan tak ke us ka jahaz doob gaya, maal zaya ho gaya aur qarz khwah us ke darwaze par khade hone lage.

dialogue.ar: وَأَغْلَقَ نَبيلٌ بابَهُ حَياءً مِنَ النّاسِ، فَلَمْ يَعْلَمْ أَحَدٌ بِحالِهِ إِلّا زَوْجَتُهُ.
dialogue.tr: waʾaghlaqa nabīlun bābahu ḥaiyāʾan mina n-nās, falam yaʿlam aḥadun biḥālihi illā zawjatuh.
dialogue.en: Nabil shut his door out of shyness before people, so no one knew his state except his wife.
dialogue.ur: Nabeel ne logon se sharm ki wajah se darwaza band kar liya, chunancha us ki biwi ke siwa kisi ko us ke haal ka ilm na hua.

dialogue.ar: مَضَتْ ثَلاثَةُ أَيّامٍ وَنَفِدَ ما في البَيْتِ، وَحَتّى زَيْتُ السِّراجِ فَرَغَ.
dialogue.tr: maḍat thalāthatu ayyāmin wanafida mā fī l-bayt, waḥattā zaytu s-sirāji faragh.
dialogue.en: Three days have passed and what was in the house has run out, even the oil of the lamp is finished.
dialogue.ur: Teen din guzar gaye, ghar mein jo tha khatam ho gaya, yahan tak ke chiragh ka tel bhi khatam ho gaya.

dialogue.ar: اصْبِري يا سُعادُ، فَالفَرَجُ قَريبٌ بِإِذْنِ اللهِ، وَالمُرُوءَةُ لا تَموتُ.
dialogue.tr: ṣbirī yā suʿād, fa-l-faraju qarībun biʾidhni Allā, wa-l-murūʾatu lā tamūt.
dialogue.en: Be patient, Suad, relief is near by Allah's permission, and chivalry does not die.
dialogue.ur: Sabr karo Suad, Allah ke hukm se kushaish qareeb hai, aur muruwwat kabhi nahin marti.

dialogue.ar: وَفي اللَّيْلِ طَرَقَ البابَ رَجُلٌ مُلَثَّمٌ، فَمَدَّ إِلى نَبيلٍ كيساً ثَقيلاً وَقالَ:
dialogue.tr: wafī l-layli ṭaraqa l-bāba rajulun mulaththamun, famadda ilā nabīlin kīsan thaqīlan waqāl:
dialogue.en: At night a masked man knocked at the door, held out a heavy bag to Nabil and said:
dialogue.ur: Raat ko ek naqabposh aadmi ne darwaza khatkhataya, Nabeel ki taraf ek bhaari thaila barhaya aur bola:

dialogue.ar: هَذا مالٌ يَكْفي لِدُيونِكَ، فَخُذْهُ يا سَيِّدي، وَلا تَسْأَلْني مَنْ أَنا.
dialogue.tr: hādhā mālun yakfī lidīūnik, fakhudhhu yā sayyidī, walā tasʾalnī man anā.
dialogue.en: This is money enough for your debts, so take it, my lord, and do not ask me who I am.
dialogue.ur: Yeh maal aap ke qarzon ke liye kaafi hai, ise le lijiye janab, aur mujh se mat poochiye ke main kaun hoon.

dialogue.ar: لا آخُذُهُ حَتّى تُخْبِرَني مَنْ تَكونُ؛ فَالكَريمُ لا يَقْبَلُ في الظَّلامِ مالاً لا يَعْرِفُ صاحِبَهُ.
dialogue.tr: lā ʾākhudhuhu ḥattā tukhbiranī man takūn; fa-l-karīmu lā yaqbalu fī ẓ-ẓalāmi mālan lā yaʿrifu ṣāḥibah.
dialogue.en: I will not take it until you tell me who you are; a generous man does not accept in the dark money whose owner he does not know.
dialogue.ur: Main ise nahin loonga jab tak aap bata na den ke aap kaun hain; sakhi andhere mein aisa maal qabool nahin karta jis ke maalik ko na jaanta ho.

dialogue.ar: أَنا جابِرُ عَثَراتِ الكِرامِ.
dialogue.tr: anā jābiru ʿatharāti l-kirām.
dialogue.en: I am the mender of the noble people's slips.
dialogue.ur: Main kareemon ki laghzishon ko sanwarne wala hoon.

dialogue.ar: وَهَلْ لَكَ عِنْدي حَقٌّ؟
dialogue.tr: wahal laka ʿindī ḥaqqun?
dialogue.en: And do you have a right with me?
dialogue.ur: Kya aap ka mujh par koi haq hai?

dialogue.ar: حينَ كُنْتَ تُعْطي لَمْ تَسْأَلْ مَنْ يَأْخُذُ، فَكُنْ مِثْلَ ما كُنْتَ الآنَ.
dialogue.tr: ḥīna kunta tuʿṭī lam tasʾal man yaʾkhudh, fakun mithla mā kunta l-ʾān.
dialogue.en: When you used to give you did not ask who was taking, so be as you were now.
dialogue.ur: Jab aap dete the to yeh nahin poochte the ke lene wala kaun hai, ab bhi waise hi rahiye.

dialogue.ar: ثُمَّ مَضى الرَّجُلُ في الظَّلامِ، وَقامَ نَبيلٌ فَسَدَّدَ لِلْغُرَماءِ ما عَلَيْهِ، وَعادَ إِلى تِجارَتِهِ.
dialogue.tr: thumma maḍā r-rajulu fī ẓ-ẓalām, waqāma nabīlun fasaddada lilghuramāʾi mā ʿalayh, waʿāda ilā tijāratih.
dialogue.en: Then the man went off into the dark, and Nabil paid the creditors what he owed and returned to his trade.
dialogue.ur: Phir woh aadmi andhere mein chala gaya aur Nabeel ne qarz khwahon ka qarz chuka diya aur apni tijarat ki taraf laut aaya.

dialogue.ar: وَبَعْدَ سَنَواتٍ بَلَغَ أَميرَ المُؤْمِنينَ خَبَرُ كَرَمِهِ، فَطَلَبَهُ، وَوَقَفَ نَبيلٌ أَمامَ الحاجِبِ.
dialogue.tr: wabaʿda sanawātin balagha amīra l-muʾminīna khabaru karamih, faṭalabah, wawaqafa nabīlun amāma l-ḥājib.
dialogue.en: After some years news of his generosity reached the Commander of the Faithful, who summoned him, and Nabil stood before the doorkeeper.
dialogue.ur: Kuch saal baad Ameer-ul-Momineen tak us ki sakhawat ki khabar pohanchi, unhon ne use bulaya aur Nabeel darban ke samne khada hua.

dialogue.ar: تَفَضَّلْ يا نَبيلُ، أَميرُ المُؤْمِنينَ يَنْتَظِرُكَ، وَقَدْ رَأى أَنْ يُوَلِّيَكَ أَمْرَ الجَزيرَةِ.
dialogue.tr: tafaḍḍal yā nabīl, amīru l-muʾminīna yantaẓiruk, waqad raʾā an yuwalliyaka amra l-jazīrati.
dialogue.en: Please come, Nabil, the Commander of the Faithful is waiting for you and has decided to appoint you over the affairs of al-Jazira.
dialogue.ur: Tashreef laiye Nabeel, Ameer-ul-Momineen aap ka intezar kar rahe hain, aur unhon ne aap ko Jazeera ke umoor ka zimmedar banane ka faisla kiya hai.

dialogue.ar: الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، ظَفِرْتُ اليَوْمَ بِما لَمْ أَحْلُمْ بِهِ، وَسُروري الأَكْبَرُ أَنَّ الخَيْرَ لا يَضيعُ.
dialogue.tr: al-ḥamdu li-llā, ẓafirtu l-yawma bimā lam aḥlum bih, wasurūrī l-ʾakbaru anna l-khayra lā yaḍīʿ.
dialogue.en: Praise be to Allah, today I have obtained what I never dreamed of, and my greatest joy is that goodness is never lost.
dialogue.ur: Alhamdulillah, aaj mujhe woh mila jis ka main ne khwab bhi nahin dekha tha, aur meri sab se bari khushi yeh hai ke bhalai kabhi zaya nahin hoti.

q.ur: «جابِرُ عَثَراتِ الكِرامِ» apne aap ko kis ne kaha?
